theater: 敘利亞東部與帕米拉綠洲

battle.name: 奧勒良
battle.theater: 敘利亞東部與帕米拉綠洲
battle.brief: 公元270年，皇帝奧勒良自安條克東進，先取卡帕多細亞的提亞納，再下安條克，最後兵臨帕米拉。沙漠圍城裡，弩砲被佈在圍城線上，對付城牆與帕米拉最銳利的騎弓。帕米拉最終開城投降，真正的毀滅則要等到272至273年。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭爆發於公元270年，交戰的兩邊是羅馬帝國與以沙漠商都帕米拉為核心的東方勢力。羅馬一方由皇帝奧勒良直接統帥，部隊來自多瑙河與伊利里亞的老防區，以及敘利亞行省的駐軍與新徵募的東方輔助兵；編制上仍沿用圖拉真改革後的極限兵力制，軍團是骨幹，每團約千人上下，其中羅馬公民兵約四、五百人，輔助兵略多於此，另有騎兵、弓手與攻城器械部隊；軍團與輔助軍混編的各營是作戰單位，沒有獨立的總參謀部，皇帝與幕僚隨軍作戰，靠營帳中逐道命令調度全軍。帕米拉一方是女王澤諾比亞為核心的城邦聯盟：澤諾比亞自稱奧古斯塔，她的兒子瓦巴拉斯在東方以奧古斯都的名號統治，帕米拉議會與長老掌握城市的行政與財政，商隊、駱駝隊與城防民兵構成後方，雇傭兵與公民兵組成軍隊，其中以騎弓著稱的帕米拉騎兵是全軍最精銳的部分；埃及的亞歷山大港與阿拉伯的商路在澤諾比亞控制之下，為她提供收入，敘利亞北部與小亞細亞東部的城鎮多數仍效忠羅馬，這使帕米拉地盤雖廣，卻腹背受敵。還有第三種力量在場：帕米拉城內住著羅馬元老級的公民與軍官，圍城後期正是他們出面與奧勒良議和，讓這場戰爭在270年以一次談判而不是一次強攻收場。
countriesEn: This war broke out in AD 270 between the Roman Empire and an eastern power built on the desert trading city of Palmyra. On the Roman side the emperor Aurelian commanded in person; the troops came from the old frontier zones on the Danube and in Illyricum, together with the garrison of the province of Syria and freshly raised eastern auxiliaries. The organisation still followed the Severan-style limited establishment: the legion was the backbone at roughly a thousand men apiece, of whom about four to five hundred were Roman citizens and rather more were auxiliaries, with cavalry, archers and siege-engine detachments alongside; mixed legion and auxiliary units were the tactical formations, there was no independent general staff, and the emperor and his staff fought from the camp and issued orders one at a time. On the Palmyrene side stood a coalition of city-states centred on Queen Zenobia: Zenobia called herself Augusta, her son Vaballathus ruled in the east under the title of Augustus, and the council and elders of Palmyra held the city's administration and finances, while caravans, camel trains and the city militia formed the rear, and mercenaries and citizen troops made up the army, the most elite part of which was the bow-armed Palmyrene cavalry. Alexandria in Egypt and the Arab caravan routes, under Zenobia's control, supplied her revenue, while most of the towns of northern Syria and eastern Asia Minor still adhered to Rome, so that Palmyra, broad as its territories were, was beset from several sides at once. A third force was present as well: Roman citizens of senatorial rank and Roman officers lived inside the city, and it was they who came forward to negotiate with Aurelian in the closing phase of the siege, which is why the war of AD 270 ended in a negotiation rather than in a storming of the walls.
people: 奧勒良是全場的絕對主角。他生於公元212年前後的貴族家庭，青年時代在歐洲各地任職，經歷了加里利安努斯時代的連年變亂，是少數在年近六十登基時仍能親自率軍連續作戰的皇帝。他靠的不是龐大的常備軍，而是軍隊對皇帝個人的忠誠：公元270年二月克劳狄烏斯二世在薊爾米烏姆病逝，他從敘利亞被部下推上皇位，四月即揮軍東進，先取卡帕多細亞的提亞納，再下安條克，最後把圍城線拉到帕米拉。他還有兩項與器械直接相關的習慣：其一是在圍城時集中使用弩砲與配重式投石器，把遠程火力當成攻城的主動手段；其二是在軍中講究實用，例如圍困帕米拉時提到只要把沙漠的沙裝滿船隊就能發財，這句玩笑被後世史家保留下來，成為全場最有名的插曲。澤諾比亞是對面的核心，出生於帕米拉城，二十多歲便以攝政與奧古斯塔的身份統治半個東方，兒子瓦巴拉斯名在前、權在握。帕米拉方面的關鍵人物還有守軍主將薩布狄亞斯與城中留居的羅馬元老馬爾庫斯；《奧勒良傳》稱薩布狄亞斯與其隊伍已受基督教洗禮，馬爾庫斯則在最後關頭代表城議會與奧勒良議定開城條件。羅馬軍中還有一個名字值得記下：逃兵朱利安，他投向帕米拉後又回到羅馬軍中，提供了城防部署的情報，被奧勒良任命率領一支分隊作戰，攻城後期正是靠這份情報縮短了抵抗。記錄這段歷史的主要來源是《歷史奧古斯都》、魯斯·佐西莫斯的《新史》與歐勒里奧·維克多的《皇帝傳略》；考古層面的佐證則有帕米拉城外澤諾比亞的沙漠宮殿，以及「三兄弟墓」一類陵墓的年代測年。
peopleEn: Aurelian is the absolute centre of the story. He came of a senatorial family around AD 212, held posts in various parts of Europe as a young man, lived through the convulsions of Gallienus' reign, and was one of the few emperors who could still fight a succession of campaigns in person at nearly sixty. What he relied on was not a huge standing army but the troops' personal loyalty to the emperor: when Claudius II died of the plague at Sirmium in February 270, Aurelian was raised on the throne by his men in Syria, and in April he was marching east, taking Tyana in Cappadocia, then Antioch, and finally dragging his siege lines up to Palmyra. He had two habits that bear directly on the equipment: first, in sieges he concentrated the bolt-throwers and the onagers, treating long-range fire as the active instrument of the siege; second, in the camp he was a soldier for practicality, remarking during the investment of Palmyra that if the sand of the desert were loaded into ships they would be rich men, a joke preserved by later historians and the best-known aside of the whole campaign. Zenobia is the opposing centre: born in the city of Palmyra, she had ruled half the east as regent and Augusta in her twenties, with Vaballathus nominally in front and the power in her hands. The other key Palmyrene figures are the garrison commander Zabdias and Marcus, a Roman senator resident in the city; the Life of Aurelian says that Zabdias and his men had already been baptised Christians, and Marcus spoke for the city council in the closing days and settled the terms of surrender with Aurelian. One more Roman name deserves a place: the deserter Julian, who had fled to Palmyra and then returned to the Roman camp, supplied intelligence on the city's defences and was appointed by Aurelian to command a detachment, and it was that intelligence which shortened the resistance in the last phase of the siege. The main sources for this stretch of history are the Historia Augusta, Zosimus' New History and Aurelius Victor's Epitome; on the archaeological side there is the desert palace of Zenobia outside Palmyra and the dating of tombs such as the Tower of the Three Brothers.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲，在這場戰爭裡的位置是圍城與野戰的火力骨幹。所謂 scorpio，在三世紀的拉丁文用法裡主要指一種輕型扭力弩砲：整具武器架在低矮的旋轉平台上，兩到三人一組操作，發射一具具粗壯的箭；較大型的一具叫作 cheiroballista，箭身長一公尺餘，含鐵頭的總重約一公斤上下，需要整組人絞緊並重新上弦，發射節奏以每分鐘數發計。公元270年的羅馬軍隊中，這類武器已經從希臘化時期的攻城重器，轉成可以跟著野戰縱隊前進的車載弩砲 carroballista：整具上架在兩輪車上，由騾子或牛牽引，行軍中收起支架，宿營時留在車旁，交戰時即在車上展開。這種配備在第三世紀尤其關鍵，因為羅馬軍團士兵在二世紀末的達西亞與帕提亞戰爭之後已經普遍卸下鎧甲，兵種核心變成持矛、靠橢圓大盾的步行兵，真正能提供遠程壓制的是輔助軍弓手與車載弩砲。圍城方面，弩砲與配重式投石器分工明確：弩砲平射壓制城牆正面與塔樓、封住射孔，專打城頭的人與馬；投石器則越過城頭，把石彈與陶製炸彈拋進城內，攻擊防禦縱深。帕米拉一方最鋒利的武器是騎弓，當地以彎弓與無鏃箭著稱，帕米拉騎兵靠馬上射擊與靈活機動，屢次讓羅馬步兵吃虧，羅馬的應對正是把車載弩砲佈置在行軍縱隊的前後兩端，用來在兩軍接觸之前先削弱其騎兵。帕米拉城牆以土坯與燒結磚砌成，外城牆周長約三公里半，設有二十餘座塔樓，牆頭寬處可容騎兵與投射器械；羅馬的攻城塔、撞錘與配重式投石器是拆牆的主力，弩砲則負責掩護這些器械免遭城頭射擊。除此之外，帕米拉一方的駱駝隊是這一帶獨特的運輸力量，羅馬方面的補給線靠從安條克與埃梅薩運來的穀物、水與柴炭，兩者在沙漠裡的距離，就是弩砲必須跟著牛車與隨軍帳篷一起移動的原因。
kitsEn: The Roman ballista on this card occupies the position of the backbone of the firepower in both siege and field work. In the Latin usage of the third century a scorpius mainly denoted a light torsion bolt-thrower: the whole machine stood on a low rotating platform, was worked by two or three men and fired heavy bolts one at a time. The larger type was the cheiroballista, with a bolt over a metre long and an iron head giving the whole missile a weight of about a kilogramme, requiring a crew to wind the torsion and reset the bow, with a rate of fire of a few bolts a minute. By AD 270 the Roman army had already turned such weapons from heavy Greek-era siege artillery into the carroballista, a cart-borne bolt-thrower that travelled with the field column: the machine sat on a two-wheeled cart drawn by mules or oxen, its stand folded away on the march and the piece unfolded on the spot. This mattered especially in the third century, because after the Dacian and Parthian wars of the late second century the Roman legionary had largely laid down his armour, the infantry core becoming spearmen behind large oval shields, and the real long-range pressure came from auxiliary archers and from the cart-borne bolt-throwers. In siege work the division of labour between the ballista and the onager was clear: the ballista fired flat to press the face of the wall and the towers and to seal the firing slits, picking off men and horses on the ramparts, while the stone-thrower lobbed stones and ceramic bombs over the wall into the depth of the defence. The sharpest weapon on the Palmyrene side was the composite bow: Palmyrene horse archers were famous for shooting from the saddle and for their manoeuvrability, and they repeatedly punished Roman infantry, and the Roman answer was to place the carroballista at the head and rear of the marching column so as to thin the enemy horse before the two sides came to grips. Palmyra's wall was built of mudbrick and fired brick, the outer circuit running to about three and a half kilometres with more than twenty towers, wide enough on the ramparts for cavalry and for engines. The Roman battering towers, rams and onagers were the instruments that broke the wall, and the ballistae covered those instruments against fire from above. Alongside these, the camel train was the distinctive transport of the region, while on the Roman side the supply line was carried by grain, water and fuel coming from Antioch and Emesa, and the length of that line across the desert is exactly why the bolt-throwers had to move with the ox-carts and the tents.
tactics: 奧勒良的打法可以歸納成四個動作：快速集結、避免在不利季節硬拼、以圍城代替野戰，以及在圍城進行中用談判瓦解守方的政治意願。公元270年他自安條克與小亞細亞出發時，刻意把部隊收攏成緊密行軍縱隊，避免在敘利亞的夏季酷熱中拉開戰線；提亞納的攻城是這套方法的第一課：他把城外制高點先拿下來，把弩砲與投石器架在有遮蔽的位置上，不急於強攻，而是以圍城與封鎖逼守軍在物資上先崩潰。安條克拿下之後，澤諾比亞放棄了這座大城，帕米拉的守軍退入沙漠綠洲的城寨，這使得羅馬軍隊必須在無水的沙海裡維持一條長達數百公里的補給線，這是帕米拉真正的戰略價值。圍城本身，羅馬的工程是標準的三世紀樣式：先構築夯土與壕溝組成的連續野戰營牆，把弩砲與投石器按射界分區配置在牆後，再以撞錘、攻城塔與地道壓制城牆；同時必須處理城外的引水渠道，帕米拉西側那道把塞馬基泉水引入城中的水渠一旦被切斷，城內存水與可持續運作的攻城器械都會受影響。守方的反擊以騎兵為主：帕米拉騎兵不與步兵糾纏，而是以連續箭雨與側擊消耗進攻方，等到進攻方攻城器械展開、陣線拉開時再出手；但羅馬人在野戰中把車載弩砲夾在行軍縱隊兩端，先以長程火力削弱這種衝擊，使騎弓失去原有的優勢。心理戰是另一個決定性環節：奧勒良進城之前對帕米拉元老會作出保證，保證城與居民不受傷害；正因如此，270年的帕米拉不是被攻破，而是被談判開城。到了272年第二次圍城，同樣的戰術骨架卻沒有同樣的政治空間，守軍在城外與城頭的抵抗更硬，最後以突擊與斷水逼出投降。
tacticsEn: Aurelian's method can be reduced to four moves: concentrate quickly, refuse to give battle in an unfavourable season, prefer the siege to the field battle, and use negotiation inside the siege to break the will of the defenders politically. When he set out from Antioch and Asia Minor in AD 270 he deliberately kept his troops closed up in a tight marching column, avoiding stretching the line in the burning summer heat of Syria; the siege of Tyana was the first lesson of this method: he took the heights around the city first, set his bolt-throwers and stone-throwers in covered positions, and did not hurry into an assault, letting the blockade and the shortage of supplies do the work on the garrison. After the fall of Antioch Zenobia abandoned the great city, and the Palmyrene garrison withdrew into the fortified oasis, which forced the Roman army to keep a supply line of several hundred kilometres open across a waterless sea of sand; that was the true strategic value of Palmyra. The siege itself followed the standard third-century pattern: a continuous camp wall of rammed earth and ditch was built first, the bolt-throwers and stone-throwers were distributed in sectors according to their arcs of fire behind it, and then the walls were battered with rams, towers and tunnels; at the same time the aqueduct outside the walls had to be dealt with, for the channel that brought the water of the Semachi spring into the city, once cut, affected the water stored inside and the engines that could be kept in action. The defenders' counter-stroke came from the cavalry: the Palmyrene horse did not remain entangled with the infantry but showered the attackers with arrows and struck the flanks, waiting for the moment when the Roman siege engines were deployed and the line had been stretched. Rome answered by putting the carroballista at both ends of the column, using long-range fire to break the weight of those charges so that the bow-armed horse lost its advantage. Psychology was the other decisive link: before entering the city Aurelian guaranteed the elders of Palmyra that the city and its people would be safe, and it was precisely for this reason that Palmyra in AD 270 was not taken by assault but opened by negotiation. In the second siege of 272 the same tactical skeleton no longer had the same political room: the resistance outside the walls and on the ramparts was harder, and the surrender was finally forced by sudden attacks and by cutting the water.
data: 幾個可對照的數字：帕米拉外城牆周長約三公里半，牆上塔樓二十餘座，圍牆所包的面積在數十公頃之內，屬於典型的沙漠石城；城內人口在羅馬時期以萬計，鼎盛期有說法指居民在數萬量級，但古代統計本身不可靠。羅馬方面的編制可以對照三世紀的帝國兵制：每個軍團的標準編制約千人出頭，其中羅馬公民兵四八〇人、輔助兵五一六人，另有軍官；奧勒良的野戰軍具體人數沒有留下可靠記載，只能說是數萬量級的常備軍與徵召兵。距離同樣關鍵：安條克到帕米拉的直線距離約五百公里，羅馬道線繞行更遠；帕米拉到幼發拉底河最近也有二百公里上下，援軍與補給都得靠這條線。武器方面，車載弩砲的有效射程在復原實測中多落在三百到四百公尺之間，足以覆蓋城頭的射孔與城牆外的道路；配重式投石器的最大射程可達四百到六百公尺，但精度差，適合打擊城內縱深。圍城時間方面，272至273年那次圍城一般記為約七個月，也有記為半年的說法，屬第三世紀最長的城市圍攻之一。奧勒良在位僅五年（270至275年），他修築的羅馬城牆後稱奧勒良城牆，周長約十九公里，牆高在數米至十餘米之間，全城僅設四座城門，是帝國晚期最浩大的城市工程之一；275年他病逝於色雷斯，全帝國的軍隊再度失去主心骨。
dataEn: A few figures for comparison. The outer circuit of Palmyra's walls ran to roughly three and a half kilometres, with more than twenty towers, and enclosed an area of some tens of hectares, a typical masonry city of the desert. The population in the Roman period ran into the tens of thousands, and the peak is sometimes put at a figure of that order, but ancient statistics are unreliable. On the Roman side the organisation can be checked against the imperial establishment of the third century: a standard legion came to a little over a thousand men, of whom 480 were Roman citizens and 516 auxiliaries, plus officers; no reliable figure survives for the size of Aurelian's field army, and it can only be called a standing army and levy in the tens of thousands. Distance matters too: the straight line from Antioch to Palmyra is about five hundred kilometres and the Roman road a little more, while Palmyra lies some two hundred kilometres from the nearest point of the Euphrates, so that both reinforcements and supplies ran along that line. As for the weapons, the effective range of the cart-borne bolt-thrower is put at three hundred to four hundred metres in reconstruction tests, enough to cover the firing slits of the wall and the roads outside it, while the onager's maximum range of four to six hundred metres was accurate enough to smash the depth of the city but not much else. As for time: the siege of 272 to 273 is generally given as about seven months, with some accounts saying half a year, and is among the longest urban sieges of the third century. Aurelian himself reigned for only five years, from 270 to 275; the circuit of walls he built around Rome, later called the Aurelian Walls, ran to roughly nineteen kilometres, rose several metres and to more than ten in places, and had only four gates for the entire city, making it one of the great building works of the late empire; he died of disease in Thrace in 275, and the armies of the empire lost their centre of gravity once more.
cause: 第一層原因是加里利安努斯在267到268年之間對帕米拉的讓步。當時帝國西線在阿蘭人與日耳曼人的壓力下岌岌可危，加里利安努斯需要東方的錢糧來支撐改革後的軍隊，於是在267年承認瓦巴拉斯在東方的奧古斯都地位，等於默許帕米拉吞下埃及、敘利亞、阿拉伯與小亞細亞的大部；澤諾比亞也確實善用這段空窗，把商路與稅收抓在手裡。第二層原因是加里利安努斯268年暴斃後的權力真空：皇位在一年之內換了克勞狄烏斯二世、奎因提盧斯與弗洛里阿努斯，帝國東部的行政與軍權被切碎，帕米拉趁機把手伸向阿拉伯與紅海，並在269年一度打到義大利，讓羅馬本土為之震動。第三層原因是奧勒良本人的處境：他被懷疑參與加里利安努斯之死，雖獲赦免並被派往東方，但他的合法性必須靠一場對外的大勝來鞏固；對東方的帕米拉作戰，同時可以切斷叛軍的財源、恢復埃及的稅收、重新得到安條克與地中海東岸的航線。第四層原因是帕米拉自身的內部張力：商隊城市的貴族、軍人與王室從來不團結，當羅馬大軍壓境、圍城開打，帕米拉內部有人選擇與皇帝談判，這條縫隙從一開始就存在。此外，羅馬帝國在270年還要同時應付北方卡魯西亞的叛亂、高盧的日耳曼壓力與不列顛的戰線，安條克與小亞細亞正是這些戰線的後方與稅源所在，因此收復敘利亞不只是雪恥，更是帝國財政與存續的必需。
causeEn: The first layer of cause was the concession Gallienus made to Palmyra between AD 267 and 268. With the western empire under pressure from the Alamanni and the Germans, Gallienus needed the money and the grain of the east to sustain his reformed army, and so in 267 he recognised the Augustan position of Vaballathus in the east, effectively letting Palmyra swallow Egypt, Syria, Arabia and most of Asia Minor; Zenobia duly used that window to put the caravan routes and the taxes of the east in her own hands. The second layer was the power vacuum left by Gallienus' death in 268: the throne changed hands within a single year through Claudius II, Quintillus and Florianus, the administration and the military command of the eastern empire were chopped into pieces, and Palmyra used the chance to extend its grip over Arabia and the Red Sea and to strike into Italy in 269, which genuinely shocked the Roman mainland. The third layer was Aurelian's own position: he was suspected of a hand in Gallienus' death, and although he was pardoned and sent east, his legitimacy had to be cemented by a great victory over an external enemy; a war against Palmyra would at once cut off the rebels' revenue, restore the taxes of Egypt, and recover the line of Antioch and the eastern Mediterranean. The fourth layer lay inside Palmyra itself: the nobles, the soldiers and the royal house of a caravan city were never united, and when a great Roman army came up and the siege began, some at Palmyra chose to negotiate with the emperor, and that seam had been there from the start. There was also the wider condition of the empire, which in 270 was simultaneously fighting the revolt of Carausius in the north, the German pressure on Gaul and the British front; Antioch and Asia Minor lay behind and beneath those fronts and paid for them, so that the reconquest of Syria was not merely a matter of vengeance but of imperial finance and survival.
impact: 270年戰役的直接影響，是羅馬帝國重新拿回敘利亞、埃及與阿拉伯商路的控制權，也拿回這條線上的關稅與穀物，這在三世紀的財政背景下意義重大：帝國的稅基長期集中在埃及、敘利亞與小亞細亞，帕米拉的獨立等於在帝國心臟上挖走一塊收入。第二是帝國權威的重申與皇帝制度的轉變：奧勒良在271年收復不列顛與高盧之後，接受了「不列顛的重建者」（Restitutor Britanniarum）與「高盧的重建者」的稱號，元老院要給他「世界的重建者」（Restitutor Orbis），他依據自己「最好的將軍」（Optimus Princeps）的風格拒絕了這個無限光榮的頭銜，這一取舍顯示三世紀末的羅馬皇帝已經自覺地把個人軍事才能當作帝國團結的關鍵。第三是帕米拉的結局：272年澤諾比亞與瓦巴拉斯再度起兵，奧勒良在安條克附近的伊瑪戰役先敗後勝，再圍帕米拉約七個月，273年城破，城牆被拆、軍隊被解散，澤諾比亞被帶往羅馬，帕米拉作為東方獨立勢力的典範從此消失，直到戴克里先時代才在戴克里先營區的基礎上部分重建。第四是象徵層面的長期效應：澤諾比亞被押往羅馬的形象，成為中世紀與近代歐洲文學裡「被皇帝俘虜的東方女皇」母題的來源之一，魯本斯在十七世紀為她作畫，把一位沙漠商城的政治人物轉成西方藝術中的悲劇女王；這也說明為什麼自三世紀末以來，這場戰爭一直被後世的文學與政治反覆挪用。
impactEn: The direct effect of the campaign of 270 was that the Roman Empire took back control of Syria, of Egypt and of the Arab caravan routes, and with them the customs and the grain on which the empire's finances rested; in the fiscal conditions of the third century this mattered greatly, because the tax base of the empire had long been concentrated in Egypt, Syria and Asia Minor, and an independent Palmyra was a block of revenue cut out of the heart of the empire. Second, the authority of the empire was reasserted and the emperorship changed shape: after recovering Britain and Gaul in 271, Aurelian accepted the titles Restitutor Britanniarum and Restitutor Galliae, and the senate proposed to give him Restitutor Orbis; in the manner of his own style, Optimus Princeps, he refused that boundless title, and the refusal shows that the Roman emperors of the late third century already consciously treated their personal military skill as the glue of the empire. Third came the fate of Palmyra: in 272 Zenobia and Vaballathus rose again, Aurelian fought the battle near Antioch, first worsted and then victorious, and then besieged Palmyra for about seven months; the city fell in 273, its walls were pulled down, its military organisation was dissolved, Zenobia was carried off to Rome, and Palmyra disappeared as the model of an independent eastern power, to be rebuilt in part on the site of Diocletian's camp in the reign of Diocletian. Fourth, at the level of symbol, the image of Zenobia led captive to Rome became one of the sources of the medieval and early-modern European motif of the queen of the east captive at the emperor's feet; Rubens painted her in the seventeenth century, and a political figure of a desert trading city was turned into the tragic queen of Western art. That is also why this war has been appropriated, again and again, by later literature and later politics.
result: 公元270年秋，帕米拉開城。澤諾比亞與瓦巴拉斯帶著殘部退往埃及，亞歷山大港隨即發生反叛，另立自己的皇帝，羅馬在埃及的統治在沒有實力對抗的情況下恢復；奧勒良沒有大掠帕米拉，他接受元老會的投降條件，保證城市的安全，只解除守軍武裝並把部分軍隊編入羅馬籍，這在第三世紀的圍城史上是罕見的克制。同一批人留下的裂縫，在272年被重新撕開：澤諾比亞與瓦巴拉斯起兵，兩軍在安條克附近的伊瑪交鋒，帕米拉騎兵一度讓奧勒良的騎兵吃虧，但羅馬步兵與弩砲在平原上站住了腳跟，帕米拉軍退回城，羅馬軍隨即展開第二次圍城。這一次沒有談判可以依靠，圍城持續約七個月，273年城破，帕米拉的城牆被拆成廢墟，澤諾比亞被俘後在羅馬去世。此後奧勒良回到西方，271至275年間修築羅馬城牆，處理高盧、不列顛與北方的問題，最終在275年病逝。戰爭的直接結果是：270年的帕米拉之戰以帕米拉內部的選擇收場，273年的第二次征討則以城市的毀滅收場；兩次合起來，羅馬帝國把三世紀最嚴重的一次分裂危機轉成了對東方的直接控制，而奧勒良本人也在五年皇帝任內，完成了別人做不到的東西兩線連續作戰。
resultEn: Palmyra opened its gates in the autumn of AD 270. Zenobia and Vaballathus withdrew with what was left of their following towards Egypt, where Alexandria rose in revolt and proclaimed an emperor of its own, and Roman rule in Egypt was restored without a serious fight; Aurelian did not sack Palmyra. He accepted the terms offered by the council, guaranteed the safety of the city, disarmed the garrison and took part of its men into Roman ranks, a restraint rare in the siege history of the third century. The seam left by those same people was torn open again in 272: Zenobia and Vaballathus rose, the two armies met near Antioch, the Palmyrene horse gave Aurelian's cavalry a hard time for a while, but the Roman infantry and the bolt-throwers held their ground on the plain, the Palmyrene army drew back into the city and the second siege opened. This time there was no room for negotiation; it lasted about seven months, the city fell in 273, the walls of Palmyra were reduced to rubble, and Zenobia died in Italy after being brought to Rome. Aurelian then turned west, built the walls of Rome between 271 and 275, dealt with Gaul, Britain and the northern front, and died of illness in 275. The immediate outcome was this: the battle for Palmyra in 270 was settled by a choice made inside Palmyra, while the second expedition of 273 was settled by the destruction of the city; taken together, the two turned the gravest division of the third century into direct Roman control of the east, and in the five years of his reign Aurelian achieved something no one else managed, campaigning on two fronts at once, west and east.
